note: Replace this file with live Neurabeach catalog data later. All items are local placeholders for the NeuraConnect prototype.

items.name: NeuraShell
items.shortDescription: Daily-driver control plane: readiness, ARM gate, freeze UI, calibration, record/replay. Simulator-first.

items.name: NeuraBinder
items.shortDescription: End-user product demo — TCG collection browser with BCI Mode and intention-friendly navigation.

items.name: NeuralBridge
items.shortDescription: Intention middleware: simulator backends, multi-client bus, policies, and app-facing intention API.

items.name: NeuraRoboBridge
items.shortDescription: Safe intention → robot path. Simulator-first robot control research prototype.

items.name: Intent → OS Adapter
items.shortDescription: Reference adapter mapping velocity/click streams to OS pointer events. Local CLI only.

items.name: Neural Flow Architect
items.shortDescription: Flow-state co-pilot research tool. Synthetic signals only in the public demo.

items.name: Signal Sandbox
items.shortDescription: Placeholder training arena for discrete intention practice (move, select, confirm).

items.name: Catalog Pulse
items.shortDescription: Lightweight status board for suite health checks and local endpoint reachability.

items.name: MindMaze Lite
items.shortDescription: Example turn-based puzzle game designed for sparse intentions instead of continuous cursor control.

items.name: Intent Lab Notebook
items.shortDescription: Research notes workspace for logging intention sessions and reviewing confidence timelines.

items.name: Calm Focus
items.shortDescription: Minimal ambient focus timer driven by discrete start/hold/stop intentions.

items.name: Gridwalker
items.shortDescription: Example grid-navigation game for validating move_up / move_down / select mappings.
